text:
Before: tea with milk (mug ~250 ml), 2 poached/steamed eggs, 2 pieces of fruit toast/raisin bread, strawberry yogurt (~100-120 g), 2 marmalade packets (~15 g each), butter pat.

After: the tea was drunk, the eggs eaten, the toast eaten (a small crumb remains), the yogurt mostly eaten (some left in the cup), one marmalade packet used, the other unused. A butter packet (foil) was used.

Estimated energy:
- Eggs, 2 × ~50 g = 100 g, ~155 kcal
- Fruit toast, ~80 g, ~220 kcal
- Butter ~10 g, ~70 kcal (the foil packet appears to have been used)
- Yogurt ~100 g eaten, ~90 kcal
- Marmalade, one packet ~15 g, ~40 kcal
- Tea with milk, ~250 g, ~30 kcal

Total is about 605 kcal. Mass is 100 + 80 + 10 + 100 + 15 + 250 = 555 g.
